props.title: Before you lace up
props.subtitle: Still have questions? Our coaches are on the floor every day.

items.question: Do I need experience to join?
items.answer: Not at all. Every program has beginner tracks, and coaches scale each session to your level.

items.question: Can I try before I commit?
items.answer: Yes — your first session is free on every plan. Just book it from the app.

items.question: Can I switch or pause my membership?
items.answer: Anytime. Upgrades are instant and pauses can last up to three months per year.
